name: Do I need to contact my insurance company before getting a wind damage repair quote?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to contact my insurance company before getting a wind damage repair quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's often beneficial to understand your insurance policy's coverage for wind damage before initiating repairs, but you can get a quote first. Many homeowners prefer to have a professional assessment and estimate from us before contacting their insurer to have a clear understanding of the repair scope and cost. We can help document the damage with photos and detailed descriptions, which can be valuable when filing your insurance claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can get a repair quote first, then contact your insurance company. Our damage documentation can support your claim.
